paper_title: Linear Time Runs Over General Ordered Alphabets
classifications: Theory of computation → Design and analysis of algorithms
statement: We have shown the first linear time algorithm for computing all runs over a general ordered alphabet. The algorithm is also very fast in practice and remarkably easy to implement. It is an open question whether our techniques could be used for the computation of runs on tries, where the best known algorithms require super-linear time even for linearly-sortable alphabets (see e.g. [26]).
